units.source_text: 如此彻夜悲叹，直到天明；

en.t: In this way he grieved and lamented through the night until dawn;

units.source_text: 镇日忧伤，以至夕暮。

en.t: all day long he remained sorrowful, until evening fell.

units.source_text: 每逢岑寂之时，便召唤几个超群出众的侍女到面前来，

en.t: Whenever loneliness overtook him, he would summon several especially gifted ladies in waiting to his side,

units.source_text: 和她们谈谈上述之类的话。

en.t: and speak with them about matters like those just mentioned.

units.source_text: 其中名叫中将君的侍女，是从小侍奉在侧的，

en.t: Among them was a lady in waiting called Chujo no Kimi, who had served at her side since childhood,

units.source_text: 源氏大约曾私下怜爱她。

en.t: and Genji seems once to have cherished her privately.

units.source_text: 但她认为对不起夫人，一向不肯和源氏亲热。

en.t: But she felt it would wrong her mistress, and had always refused to become intimate with Genji.

units.source_text: 如今夫人亡故了，源氏想起这是夫人生前特别疼爱的人，

en.t: Now that the lady had died, Genji remembered that this was someone she had especially loved in life,

units.source_text: 便把她看作夫人的遗爱，对她格外垂青。

en.t: and he regarded her as a keepsake of the lady, showing her particular favor.

units.source_text: 这中将君的品性和容貌都不坏，正像夫人墓上的一株青松。

en.t: This Chujo no Kimi was pleasing in both character and appearance, like a green pine standing beside the lady's grave.

units.source_text: 所以源氏对待她，和对待普通侍女迥不相同。

en.t: For that reason, Genji treated her quite differently from ordinary ladies in waiting.

units.source_text: 凡疏远的人，源氏一概不见。

en.t: As for anyone who was not close to him, Genji refused to see them all.

units.source_text: 朝中公卿对他都很亲睦，他的诸兄弟亲王常常来访问他，

en.t: The court nobles were all on friendly terms with him, and his princely brothers often came to visit,

units.source_text: 然而他很少接见。

en.t: yet he rarely received them.

units.source_text: 他想：“我只有和客人见面的时候，才能抑制哀思，强自镇静。

en.t: He thought, "Only when I meet guests can I restrain my grief and force myself to stay calm.

units.source_text: 然而痴迷了几个月，形容萎靡，语言未免乖僻，

en.t: But after months of this derangement, my appearance has withered, and my speech is bound to sound strange,

units.source_text: 深恐惹起后人议论，甚至身后流传恶名。

en.t: so I deeply fear provoking criticism from later generations, or even leaving a bad name after my death.

units.source_text: 外人传说我‘丧妻后神情痴迷，不能见客’，虽然同是恶评，

en.t: If outsiders say of me, 'After losing his wife, he became distraught and could not receive guests,' that too is a reproach,

units.source_text: 但听人传说而想象我痴迷之状，总比亲眼目睹我的丑态好得多。”

en.t: but having people imagine my madness from hearsay is still far better than letting them see my wretched state with their own eyes."

units.source_text: 因此连夕雾等人来访，也都隔帘对晤。

en.t: Therefore, even when Yugiri and others came to visit, he met them only from behind a curtain.

units.source_text: 当外人传说他心情变异期间，他竭力镇静，忍耐度日。

en.t: During the time when outsiders were saying that his mind had changed, he did his utmost to remain composed and endured each day.

units.source_text: 但终不能抛弃浮世，毅然出家。

en.t: Yet in the end he could not cast off the floating world and resolutely become a monk.

units.source_text: 难得到诸夫人处走动。

en.t: Only rarely did he go about visiting the other ladies.

units.source_text: 然而一走进门，立刻泪如雨下，难于制止，不胜其苦。

en.t: But as soon as he entered the gate, tears fell like rain, impossible to hold back, and the pain was more than he could bear.

units.source_text: 就连无论何人都疏远了。

en.t: In the end, he withdrew from everyone, no matter who they were.
